GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the widest barrier, rdr elected to remain racing wide down back straight before crossing over towards the field rounding 1st turn to settle outside leader near 800m. Rdr stated mount settled outside leader & travelled comfortably in e&m stages. Rdr stated mount failed to sprint strongly on straightening before peaking on run app 200m & weakening thereafter.  Rdr added he did not test mount over final 100m when a beaten horse. Tnr stated geld did not appear to let down on heavy track. P/R vet of geld, attempting 1400m journey for 1st time on heavy track conditions, revealed no ab's.
